tools.name: mtg_deck_check
tools.description: FREE MTG deck check: legality + mana curve (Commander/EDH, Standard, Modern, Pioneer, Pauper...). Paste a decklist (Arena, MTGO, Moxfield or plain text). Checks deck size, copy limits, banned/restricted/not-legal cards, Commander singleton and color identity, and returns mana curve, average mana val

tools.name: mtg_opening_hand_odds
tools.description: FREE MTG opening hand sim: odds for one card. Chance that a card you run N copies of is in your opening hand (60-card, Commander 99, Limited 40). For several cards at once and turn-by-turn odds use mtg_draw_odds ($0.001). (free, no payment)

tools.name: mtg_draw_odds
tools.description: MTG draw sim: exact odds to draw your cards by turn N. Exact odds of drawing one or more cards (or card groups, jointly) in the opening hand and by each turn, on the play or on the draw. "What are my odds of having Lightning Bolt and 2 lands by turn 2?" Presets: mtg (60), commander (99 library, draw

tools.name: mtg_land_count
tools.description: MTG mana sim: land count and color sources. How many lands should my deck play, and how many sources of each color do I need? Returns the land count needed to hit each land drop on curve at your target probability (default 90%), checks your current land count turn by turn, and gives colored-source c

tools.name: mtg_goldfish
tools.description: MTG goldfish simulator + mulligan sim for a pasted decklist. Paste a decklist (Arena, MTGO, Moxfield or plain "4 Card Name") and get a seeded Monte Carlo goldfish: London-mulligan rate with your keep rule, land drops and mana screw by turn, and the odds of your own goals ("Goblin Guide on turn 1", "

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mtg_goldfish · Private data: mtg_draw_odds, mtg_land_count, mtg_goldfish · Public sink: mtg_draw_odds, mtg_land_count, mtg_goldfish · Destructive: mtg_opening_hand_odds, mtg_land_count.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mtg_goldfish · Private data: mtg_draw_odds, mtg_land_count, mtg_goldfish · Public sink: mtg_draw_odds, mtg_land_count, mtg_goldfish · Destructive: mtg_opening_hand_odds, mtg_land_count

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
